scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm test -w api && npm test -w web
scripts.lint: oxlint api/src api/tests api/scripts e2e playwright.config.ts && oxlint -c web/.oxlintrc.json web/src
scripts.pretest:e2e: playwright install chromium && npm run db:setup
